paragraphs: CrowdRiff sells visual content software to travel brands, with the stated aim of giving them content and insights that inspire travelers. The pitch is to plan, produce and measure content in one place, replacing multiple tools with one connected solution.

The platform collects user-generated content from a destination, with curation and rights approval before anything is published. It also sources original short-form video to fuel Instagram Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts. Visuals are centralized so a team can search, organize and share content instead of digging through folders and drives.

The site states that more than 900 destinations use CrowdRiff for their visual content. Customer stories cover destination marketing organizations, including one on how Destination Madison plans and produces content. The founders describe starting the company with the vision of a local-first travel ecosystem. It also partners with agencies around the world to help their clients use user-generated content and owned visuals.

quote.text: Don’t just market your destination. Showcase it.
